reason: A chat utility that lets users edit and resend the latest text message by creating a child session before it and restoring the message to the composer.

summaries.zh: 在兼容的 DeepSeek Harness 主机中，将最新文本用户消息编辑并重新发送到新建的子会话中。
summaries.en: On compatible DeepSeek Harness hosts, edit and resend the latest text user message in a newly forked child session.

capabilities: Adds an edit action to the latest committed user message
Forks a child session before the selected message
Restores the original message text to the child composer for editing
